result.rationale: The diff adds totalPages: Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. With user_count exactly divisible by limit (e.g. 50/50), floor gives 1, +1 gives 2 pages, but only one page of members exists; showingLast (currentPage == totalPages) will never be true on the real last page, so 'next' stays enabled and navigates to an empty member list. Classic pagination off-by-one (should be Math.ceil or Math.floor((count-1)/limit)+1). Verifiable directly from the diff.

adjudication.rationale: In admin-group.js.es6, totalPages returns Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1 when user_count>0. For an exact multiple (e.g. user_count=50, limit=50) this yields 2 pages although only one page of results exists. The "next" action then sets offset to Math.min(offset+limit, user_count) (0->50) and Group.findMembers requests offset=50, producing an empty members list from /groups/:name/members.json. This matches the finding: a phantom extra page and next enabled when it shouldn't be.
